title: Partial GFlowNet: Accelerating Convergence in Large State Spaces via Strategic Partitioning
abstract: arXiv:2602.11498v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) have shown promising potential to generate high-scoring candidates with probability proportional to their rewards. As existing GFlowNets freely explore in state space, they encounter significant convergence challenges when scaling to large state spaces. Addressing this issue, this paper proposes to restrict the exploration of actor. A planner is introduced to partition the entire state space into overlapping partial state spaces. Given their limited size, these partial state spaces allow the actor to efficiently identify subregions with higher rewards. A heuristic strategy is introduced to switch partial regions thus preventing the actor from wasting time exploring fully explored or low-reward partial regions. By iteratively exploring these partial state spaces, the actor learns to converge towards the high-reward subregions within the entire state space. Experiments on several widely used dataset

translated_title: 局部GFlowNet：通过策略性划分加速大状态空间中的收敛
translated_abstract: 生成流网络已展现出以与奖励成正比的概率生成高分候选对象的巨大潜力。由于现有GFlowNet在状态空间中自由探索，当扩展到大型状态空间时，它们面临显著的收敛挑战。针对这一问题，本文提出限制执行器（actor）的探索范围。本文引入一个规划器将整个状态空间划分为重叠的局部状态空间。由于其规模有限，这些局部状态空间使执行器能够高效地识别具有更高奖励的子区域。此外，本文引入了一种启发式策略来切换局部区域，从而防止执行器浪费时间探索已被充分探索或低奖励的局部区域。通过迭代探索这些局部状态空间，执行器学会收敛到整个状态空间中的高奖励子区域。在多个广泛使用的数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出局部GFlowNet，通过规划器将大型状态空间划分为重叠的局部状态空间，并配合启发式区域切换策略限制智能体的探索范围，从而加速其在大型状态空间中向高奖励子区域的收敛。
